message.content: Fusion research has already created valuable spinoffs for society. High temperature superconductors developed for magnetic confinement now enable more efficient MRI machines and compact medical devices for many hospitals around the world. Neutron sources used for material testing improve nondestructive inspection in aerospace and nuclear safety. Plasma diagnostics techniques have advanced environmental monitoring detecting pollutants with greater sensitivity. This iritic example shows that laboratory fusion work can translate into practical benefits for health, energy, and industry. Continued investment may accelerate medical materials and climate technologies while advancing clean electricity.
